title: Copilot in VS Code could enable its own auto-approve setting
summary: GitHub Copilot could edit .vscode/settings.json in the workspace it was working on, so a prompt injection could add chat.tools.autoApprove and remove the confirmation step for every later tool call, reaching arbitrary command execution. Microsoft patched it on 12 August 2025.
severity_rationale: Injected content can disable the approval control that separates suggestion from execution, and the resulting state persists in the workspace.
